topography.project_purpose: Options. Structurally: 247 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 9 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 30 common project-authored base contract(s) (dsmath, merkledistributorwithdeadline, merkledistributor). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
